chunks: And from him, from Abu Khalid Al-Qammat, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The glorification of Fatima (peace be upon her) every day at the end of every prayer is more beloved to me than a prayer of a thousand units (rak'at) every day.'

key_terms.تَسْبِيحُ: Glorification (specifically referring to the Tasbih of Fatima)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Tasbih Fatima compared to other forms of prayer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the daily recitation of Tasbih Fatima after each obligatory prayer above a thousand units of voluntary prayer, underscoring its unique status in Shia devotional practice. This hadith, recorded in al-Kafi, reflects the Ahl al-Bayt's emphasis on concise, potent dhikr that encapsulates gratitude and divine attributes, making it accessible for consistent daily practice. The preference for this specific supplication highlights the spiritual efficacy of the Prophet's household's teachings over mere quantity of worship.
